subject.title: Android node notification forwarding causes cross-session replies (WhatsApp duplicate sends to wrong group)

question: Which boundary should own the fix for Android-forwarded native-channel notifications that can reach node sessions and drive outbound channel messages?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the durable fix changes security and product behavior across Android package policy, gateway notification ingestion, and message-tool outbound routing.

options.title: Enforce session/tool boundary
options.body: Block node-session outbound sends to unrelated native channels and add native-channel notification suppression as defense in depth.

options.title: Android package policy only
options.body: Default-block known native-channel packages in Android forwarding settings, leaving gateway and message-tool behavior otherwise unchanged.

options.title: Gateway dedupe/reject path
options.body: Reject or dedupe native-channel package notifications at gateway ingress, possibly with operator-visible configuration and migration proof.

recommendation.title: Enforce session/tool boundary
recommendation.body: Block node-session outbound sends to unrelated native channels and add native-channel notification suppression as defense in depth.

likelyOwner.reason: The original notification-event gateway work is the central cross-session routing boundary.
